VGO
VGO: Vegan option, prepared with vegan cheese and ingredients
VO: Vegetarian option, meat replaced with plant-based alternatives
HO: Halal option, prepared using halal-compliant ingredients and procedures
GFO: Gluten-free option, accredited by Coeliac Australia, with approved ingredients and processes

Modify your pizza

  • Extra bread (gluten free or not) +2
  • add pomodoro +1
  • add mozzarella +3
  • add any vegetable +3
  • add speciality cheeses +4
  • add salumi +5
  • add prosciutto, prawns, bufala or burrata +6

Dietary options

  • Cavatelli gluten free pasta +4
  • House-made gluten free gnocchi +5
  • House-made pasta options (not gluten free) +4
  • Roman base (thin and crunchy) +1
  • House-made gluten free pizza +5

Please advise our staff of any dietary requirements or allergies at the time of ordering, thank you.

No garlic. No onion. No compromise.

Many guests avoid garlic and onion for health, digestive or personal reasons. Our kitchen prepares dishes without them on request: gentle for sensitive stomachs and IBS, suitable for low-FODMAP and Jain diets, freshly prepared to order.

Peanuts and tree nuts are handled on the premises. Gluten free menu, ingredients and processes are reviewed and accredited by Coeliac Australia.

Our people, our place

A neighbourhood pizzeria for everyone.

Lorenzo Tron, from Trieste, and Roberto Davoli, from Reggio Emilia, founded SHOP225 in late 2016 after taking over a shop on Melville Road.

Two founders can't feed a suburb on their own. Long before the doors open, someone on this crew is stacking wood for the oven, someone is giving the dough its final stretch, and someone is running the checks that keep every gluten-free, vegan and halal-friendly order safe.

Join our hands-on cooking classes, bring us along for at home catering, or gather up to 26 guests in our private function room, The Secret Garden.

Our sister venues: Il Caminetto and Pronto478.
